resource: Location/custody lines in one DUR-03 native one-item logical transaction
allocation_impact: Checked before allocation or partial mutation; never truncated. MINT has one Ground destination; TRANSFER has one Ground source and at most one destination line (the container slot or a new main-backpack entry; a B3 full merge has only the Ground removal).
boundary_tests: max=2: a TRANSFER with one source and one destination line is accepted
max+1=3: an additional or duplicated location line is rejected
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/item_mint_audit.rs (stage C runtime MINT: TransactionResourceUsage::MINT checked before freeze and in the payload gate)
apps/game-server/src/durability/item_transfer_audit.rs (B3-1 runtime TRANSFER: TransferShape::usage checked in the payload gate and before commit)
apps/game-server/src/durability/house_interior_audit.rs and house_interior.rs (HOUSE-RUNTIME-1a: closed one-item House place/take/tile-move, same-transaction custody/receipt/event)
